mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% for two consecutive months signals weakening consumer demand and profit pressure, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) for three consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of three consecutive quarterly GDPC1 declines (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above its 12-month moving average by more than 2% for three consecutive months signals improving manufacturing activity and earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when INDPRO exceeds its 12-month MA by more than 2% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% for three consecutive months signals a restrictive monetary policy stance, increasing discount rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in payroll employment (PAYEMS) above its 12-month moving average by more than 1% for two consecutive months signals labor market strength, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when PAYEMS exceeds its 12-month MA by more than 1% for two months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Housing Starts Index (HOUST) above its 12-month moving average by more than 5% for three consecutive months signals strengthening residential demand, which boosts construction sector earnings and supports broader equity valuations, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods when HOUST exceeds its 12-month MA by more than 5% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 3% for three consecutive months signals persistent inflation, which increases the likelihood of aggressive monetary tightening and reduces equity valuations, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when CPIAUCSL > 3% for three months (t-test p > 0.05).
